summary.button: A button that triggers an action, with five appearances and three sizes.
summary.input: Single-line / multi-line text input, supporting headers, descriptions and password forms.
summary.scroll-view: A container that scrolls, pans and zooms content that overflows the viewport.
summary.icons: WinUI 3 / Fluent System Icons icon components.
summary.checkbox: Select one or more items from a set, with an indeterminate state.
summary.combobox: Pick one option from a list, with text search and an editable mode.
summary.number-box: Enter numbers with range validation, stepping and inline expressions.
summary.radio-group: Choose one option from a mutually exclusive group.
summary.slider: Drag to pick a value along a continuous range.
summary.switch: Toggle between an on and off state.
summary.config-provider: The locale injection point for the library's built-in text: switch language and override individual strings.
summary.content-dialog: A modal dialog: title + body + primary / secondary / close buttons.
summary.info-badge: A non-intrusive small badge: dot / value / icon states.
summary.infobar: An app-level status banner with four severities and a closable mode.
summary.progress: Linear progress indicator: indeterminate slider and determinate fill.
summary.progress-ring: Circular progress indicator: indeterminate spinner and determinate arc.
summary.tooltip: A supplementary info overlay shown on hover or focus.

compact.headerColumns: Grid columns (up / down buttons appear on focus)

disabled.note: When disabled, the input box falls to the TextControl…Disabled tier and the spin buttons move to …ForegroundDisabled; the header and description both gray out.

format.descriptionInteger: 25.8 displays as 26 — the same look as WinUI's default DecimalFormatter with FractionDigits(0)

inline.headerFontSize: Font size (hold the button to keep stepping)
inline.note: The inline buttons and the input box share one TextBox border: the buttons are 32×24 with margin 4 and corner radius 4, repeating every 250ms while held (the WinUI RepeatButton Delay / Interval defaults).

step.note: Arrow keys / wheel move by step, PageUp / PageDown by largeStep; out-of-range values are clamped to the range, and — as with WinUI — there is no step snapping.

password.note: WinUI rule: the reveal button appears only after focus, and only after typing has begun from empty during that focus. The password box above is prefilled — clear it and type again to see the button; the one below (the native masking path) has no prefilled content, so typing shows it immediately.
